The accuracy is further improved through stacking ensemble procedure providing an accuracy of 96.7%. A novel technique of stacking ensemble is considered for the best 3 transfer learning models of ResNet50, VGG19, and MobileNetV3Large, with which the achieved accuracy is 98.3%.

articleTitle: Recognition of Power Transformer Fault Based on Dissolved Gas Analysis using Fuzzy Logic Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: The primary goal of the proposed study is to identify the fault type in the high voltage transformer using a fuzzy logic technique with tuned hyperparameters based on pattern search optimization. Based on the dissolved gas analysis results, fault types in the transformer are identified (DGA). For DGA analysis, this suggested study employs the conventional methodology, the International Electrotechnical Commission ratio (IEC), and the Duval triangle technique. There are transformer faults utilized. The fuzzy logic approach's hyperparameters are optimized using the pattern search optimization technique to improve the performance of the proposed work. In addition, four different fuzzy inference systems are used in this proposed work for further investigation. An intelligent maintenance approach is advised for efficient planning to prevent significant damage to the power transformer.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of Polyphase based FHSS modulator using GNU Radio and SDR
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: Wireless communication is the fastest-growing sector in the communication industry. The nature of wirelessly transmitted signals makes them prone to eavesdropping and jamming. The intercepting of these signals leads to the leaking of sensitive data and poses a threat. As a result, the security and dependability of wireless systems are jeopardized. Spread Spectrum enables the signal to be spread out over a larger bandwidth before transmission. Frequency Hopping Spread Spectrum (FHSS) prevents the transmitted signal from eavesdropping by hopping onto different carrier frequencies. FHSS has been prominently used in military applications and wireless standards such as Bluetooth. The higher the hopping bandwidth, the more immune is the system to interferences. A digital FHSS system based on Polyphase channelizers is designed using Software Defined Radios (SDR). Polyphase channelizers utilize N-point Inverse Fast Fourier Transform (IFFT) for inverse Fourier transformation, the computational efficiency of using IFFT is discussed. The SDR approach is used to implement Frequency Hopping Spread Spectrum as they offer faster prototyping and reliability. Using GNU Radio and Universal Software Radio Peripheral, a digital-based Frequency Hopping Spread Spectrum modulator using Polyphase channelizers is designed and implemented in real time.

articleTitle: Machine Learning based framework to predict the Network Usage in Smart Parking Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: The automotive industry is growing daily, as many people prefer personal vehicles for many reasons. Due to the increased usage of private cars, especially in growing cities, parking space availability has become short and poses a big challenge. It also leads to further cascaded issues like traffic congestion, wasting time in finding free space, polluting the environment, and especially unnecessary wastage of fuel. Therefore inventing a smart parking system has become the need of the hour. Many researchers have attempted to design solutions to this issue by utilizing state-of-the-art technology in prominent areas like Wireless Sensor Networks, Cloud Computing, and Internet of Things. However, there is still scope for improvement in smart parking system performance. In this research work, we are simulating a smart parking system to get the parameters like network usage, transmission time, number of areas, and number of cameras used. The simulator works better for a small number of areas, but for larger-scale simulations, it takes more time. Hence, we propose a framework that can predict/analyze the performance of smart parking systems at an enormous scale using an ML algorithm. The experimental results show that predicting network usage of large-scale smart parking systems using an ML framework is 1500x faster than the simulation time of the CloudSim simulator.

articleTitle: ABC-DE-WOA: A New Hybrid Algorithm for Optimization Problems
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: One of the most effective swarm intelligence-based algorithms for many global optimization issues is the Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) strategy. Despite the fact that there are many Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) variants, the algorithm normally has a low convergence rate. Therefore, it is still essential to moderate an algorithm's intensity and diversity. In this instance, the standard Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) algorithm has been combined with the Whale Optimization Algorithm (WOA) and Differential Evolution Algorithm (DE) to generate a novel Hybrid Artificial Bee Colony algorithm (ABC), Artificial Bee Colony-Differential Evolution-Whale Optimization Algorithm (ABC-DE-WOA). For simple benchmark problems with up to 100 dimensions, 50 dimensions, 30 dimensions, and 10 dimensions, the proposed hybrid technique is compared with Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) variants like Artificial Bee Colony-Whale Optimization Algorithm (ABC-WOA), Artificial Bee Colony-Differential Evolution Algorithm (ABC-DE), and original Artificial Bee Colony Algorithm (ABC). The results show that the proposed technique performs better than its competitors in terms of convergence speed.

articleTitle: Realization of Fractional order Multivibrator using different approximation techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: The working of free running multivibrators using fractional order capacitor is studied in this paper. Initially rational approximation methods for the fractional order operator are deeply investigated. Then an equivalent RC circuit is synthesized. The synthesized circuit is used in place of fractional order capacitor. The performance of the circuit is studied by making use of different approximation techniques. It has been observed that the curve fitting based approximation has produced higher frequencies compared to others when fourth order approximation is used. All simulations are carried out using TINA software.

articleTitle: Scaling Up a Cloud Microservices Simulator
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: Cloud services have recently shifted from single-tiered software applications to a complex collection of microservices. Microservices architectures allow applications to be scaled swiftly and easily, thus shortening the time it takes to market new features. However, there are some problems that need to be solved before this utility computing vision can be fully realised. The microservices architecture has several benefits, but as we scale up their often behaviour becomes quite unpredictable. To analyse and improve upon this problem, we aim to scale up MuSim, an open-source microservice simulator, drawing inspiration from DeathStarBench.

articleTitle: A Tenable Approach to Detect Brain Haemorrhage Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: One of the most important stages for detection of brain haemorrhage in patients is the early diagnosis which requires radiologist's assessment of CT scans. In order to automate the procedure for early diagnosis, CNN models are built which classifies a CT scan brain image to normal images (without haemorrhage) and abnormal images (with haemorrhage). The dataset used are 752,803 DCM files provided by the “Radiological Society of North America (RSNA)”. Out of total number of files 215k is considered as total number of DCM files for training and testing for the model, in which 100k files are for training, 65k for testing and 45k for validation. The DenseNet121 model has 90% accuracy on each class and 89.6% accuracy on each image. The ResNet50 model has 88% accuracy on each class and 87.9<sup>%</sup> accuracy on each image. From both models DenseNet121 model performance better in predicting the classes.

articleTitle: Hybrid Machine Learning Model Using Particle Swarm Optimization for Effectual Diagnosis of Alzheimer's Disease from Handwriting
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a condition that weakens nerves, impairs cognitive and memory functions, and eventually results in amnesia. An improved approach for early diagnosis of AD is crucial to identify and control the decline as they advance. Machine Learning (ML) approaches have proved successful in intelligently identifying patterns in the data to categorize it into different classes. Hybrid ML models with Swarm Intelligence (SI) based feature selection will result in robust and efficient model for diagnosis and prediction. In this work, Particle Swarm Optimization has been used for feature selection to identify the best performing feature dimension resulting in a hybrid ML model with good performance. Six classifier models have been explored in the hybrid ML.

articleTitle: StaVen: A Secure and Lightweight PWA for Traffic Facilitation
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: To resolve the difficulties with the existing transport system such as traffic congestion, infrastructural improvements could no longer be the only resolution. It demands the aid of IT. Information technology supports components in the road transport systems such as traffic lights, sign boards, toll machines to be smart with the advancement of sensors to communicate with each other via wireless technology. Vehicular Ad-hoc NETwork (VANET), is one such research area, where there is a wireless communication between vehicles. With the advancement and sophistication of VANET and the development of high-level applications, there will be a massive disruption in the field of wireless communication in terms of rapid handovers, network availability, security, and safety. There is also an urgent need for effective trust management, given the dire consequences of acting on false information sent out by malicious peers. In this article, we discuss the design of a Progressive Web Application (PWA) called StaVen (which is an anagram of VANET-S where ‘S’ stands for Secured) to facilitate the traffic for first responders to help them reach the site of the accident within the golden period, and also improve the safety standards..

articleTitle: Implementation of Carlson approximation based Fractional Order Butterworth Lowpass Filter using Differential Voltage Current Conveyor
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: This study implements a Differential Voltage Current Conveyor (DVCC)-based fractional order Butterworth lowpass filter based on the Carlson approximation and two fractance devices. The transfer function of a fractional order system is originally determined. The conventional fractional order Butterworth equation is then used to compare the transfer function of the created system. This may be equaled to obtain the general situation in which the created system acts as a Butterworth filter of fractional order. Monte Carlo analysis is also a component of the inquiry. The Carlson and Halijak approximation is one of the rational approximations of a fractional capacitor device using a common Newton procedure (RC network). A fractional order Butterworth lowpass filter is simulated in the PSpice environment to confirm the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Vasculature Detection in Tympanic Membrane
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: Tympanic membrane, an essential part of the human ear whose function is to help in hearing. In this paper, novelty-based characterization of the tympanic membrane using its vasculature is proposed. In part (1) digital image processing techniques were used for the detection of the blood vessels. In this green channel extraction followed by pre-processing techniques like CLAHE and OTSU thresholding were performed. Vessel detection was done by using Morphological Operation combined with Canny Edge Detection. In part (2) Histogram and pixel-based techniques were used for quantization of blood vessels. Result analysis was done using percentage of vasculature and speed of the algorithm used in the finding the percentage of vasculature. Comparison between Sobel edge detection and Canny edge detection was performed to choose the best method.

articleTitle: An In-Depth Investigation of Cyber-Attack and Cyber Security: Emerging Trends and Current Events
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: The intricacy and originality of harmful software (also known as malware) have grown with time, despite the fact that it has existed since the invention of computers. The term “malware” (or “malicious code”) refers to software that carries out an attacker's malicious intent. Finding out how a piece of malware behaves and what it's likely to be used for is called malware analysis (such as Trojans horse, worms and virus). Malware may be identified and categorized into recognized families by exploiting its behavior and any patterns that follow it, whether they are static or dynamic. This survey study will give an outline of the methods for examining and categorizing the malware.

articleTitle: State Feedback Controller Design via an Algebraic Approach for Damping Enhancement in a Large Interconnected Electric Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: This paper presents an Algebraic Approach (AA) for tuning Linear Quadratic Regulator (LQR) for improving the damping performance of a large-scale interconnected electric power system. The proposed approach makes use of the relationship between the law that optimizes the state feedback gain (K) and the Algebraic-Riccati-Equation (ARE) to derive algebraic expressions for estimating the optimal state weighting matrix (Q) of the system that facilitates tuning of optimal LQR effortless in the multi-machine environment. An IEEE test system comprising 10 generators and 39 buses has been considered to investigate the damping performance of the proposed optimal LQR.

articleTitle: Munkres assignment algorithm for optimal reconfiguration to improve GMPP of partially shaded PV array system
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: The undesirable effects of environmental conditions on solar PV systems are very problematic manner due to the low power generation delivery to load. Major issue of changing nature of sun irradiance during the entire day is major environmental concerns, which is also major cause of occurring partial shading conditions (PSCs). These shading impacts are assessed through the characterization in terms of output characteristic curves. Especially the existence of multiple power peaks in terms of GMPP and LMPP on the electrical characteristics based on the critical analysis. In present study, swarm intelligence technique such as Munkres assignment algorithm (MAA) is adopted to the dynamic alternation/reconfiguration of PV modules in array to enhance the shade dispersion on entire array. The considered MA algorithm (MAA) based PV array re-configuration is weighted against existing SP and TCT PV array arrangements using MATLAB/Simulink environment in terms of various performance indices.

articleTitle: Data Driven Machine Learning Model for Audiometric Threshold classification
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: Hearing loss is defined as the inability to hear partially or completely, in one or both the ears. It is present in people of all age groups. The continuous exposure to noise in today's world, aging and congenital defects are leading causes of hearing loss. Hearing loss can be present in new born as a result of maternal infections during pregnancy, complications after birth and head trauma. This study will develop a model to estimate the degree of Hearing loss of a sample set of people in the 18–22 age group. The hearing loss was calculated based on the intensity threshold values that was generated by the Smartphone mobile application-based hearing test [1] [2]. This threshold value was compared with the standard audiometric table to classify the sample set into two groups. Support Vector Machine (SVM) was used for building the binary classification model. The Support Vector Machine searches for an optimum hyperplane to classify the two groups. It uses the extreme points, termed as support vectors, to create the hyperplane. The hyperplane is created so as to maximize the margin, which is the distance between the hyperplane and the support vectors. The support vector machine algorithm supports different kernels for building a model. Three different kernels - Linear kernel, Polynomial kernel and Radial Basis function were used with three different training set sizes - 80% training size, 75% training size and 70% training size to select a model of high accuracy. The model with the highest accuracy was tested, and the confusion matrix of the test set data is obtained to verify the results. A classification report provides the values of Precision, Recall and F1 score to assess the quality of the model developed.

articleTitle: Survey on Congestion Control Approaches in 4G/5G Cellular Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: In the last few decades, cellular networks have undergone a massive evolution. Cellular networks support high bit rates with low loss rates in data transmission. But the applications that use cellular networks face congestion related challenges. To overcome this issue and to improve the network performance 4G/5G networks are proposed. As the need for video streaming and multimedia transfer increases, the problems associated with these applications also become more real. One of the main challenges faced when transferring large amounts of data of varying formats is Network Congestion. This leads to problems like low throughput, ineffective bandwidth utilization, and high delay. These issues can be majorly attributed to the fact that the advancement in the transport layer has not been as rapid as the increase in the needs of cellular networks. In this survey, we will be looking at some of the commonly used congestion control algorithms and examining the reasons why these algorithms work well or do not work well for 4G/5G cellular networks..

articleTitle: Interactive VBE and IPSL Aid for the Disabled using a GRU-based Model
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: In a world of billions communication becomes the radical thing that makes us human. Without communication, people are mere objects with a soul. Unfortunately, not all of us are blessed with being able to communicate freely. Interaction between the disabled and the ordinary poses a huge challenge. This paper proposes to solve this problem by developing a sign language identifier by combining machine learning and web development techniques to aid the needy. IPSL (Indo-Pakistani Sign Language) is one such language that is not represented as much as it should be. Despite being used actively by more than 15 Million people in the deaf community, IPSL is unknown to most of the world. IPSL will be made detectable with the proposed model that is combined with a VBE (Voice Based Email) system to aid not only the deaf but also the blind, using a GRU model for the same. GRU is already a well defined model, but this paper intends to show how this deep learning model can be used for IPSL, having never been done before, as it is usually done for the popular languages like ASL and BSL.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Vertical Axis Wind Turbine with Optimized Mass of NACA0018 Blade Profile
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: Wind is one of the most reliable sources of renewable energy and is gaining more popularity in the regions where transmission and distribution of conventional electrical power is not practicable. In such areas this necessitates the installation of wind turbines to produce electrical power. The power generated by a wind turbine depends on its size. Greater the size of the turbine, more will be the power output. Hence, larger turbines are required to produce higher output power. As the size of the turbine increases, complexity and cost of installation also increase. To minimize this complexity, in this paper smaller wind turbine is considered for the analysis and the blade is designed to obtain the required electrical power. This paper proposes the novel blade design to produce electrical power for a small Vertical Axis Wind turbine (VAWT). Structural vibrations are one of the major drawbacks of VAWTs which can be reduced by choosing a suitable aspect ratio. Mass of the blade at the leading edge is increased to improve the rotational speed and compared to performance of the turbines with existing blade standards. The proposed blade is aerodynamically shaped and is designed by considering an airfoil with NACA0018 nomenclature. Aerodynamic nature of the blade enhances the rotational speed of the turbine rotor by extracting more kinetic energy from the wind. Mass of the existing blade and modified blade are compared and is analytically verified to validate the proposed design.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Controller Based Transformer Less CHB Inverter for Grid Connected PV Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: The plan of a 3-phase transformer less cascaded H bridge (CHB) converter with fuzzy logic controller (FLC) is presented in this paper. Among the conventional multi-level inverter (MLI) topologies CHB obtaining huge popularity because of its intrinsic features best suitable for high-power applications. Solar- Pvenergy is integrated with the grid to provide quality power and reach the power demand. Produce higher multi-level output voltage separate DC link lower voltage sources are needed. Multiple PV sources are treated as low voltage sources to the CHB converter. These lower voltage sources are diminishing the voltage stress on the appliances. The challenging task to design CHB converters is because of the presence of multiple low voltage (PV) sources, which can generate additional passages for leakage current. The prime focus of this article is to lessen the leakage current at the source side with the proposed fuzzy logic controller. The proposed transformer-less converter topology is composed of six switches in each phase and possesses the feature of both dc and ac bypass circuit features. To operate switches accurately a novel fuzzy-based modulation control technique. It is dependent on a sine triangle PWM procedure paired by means of allocated logic functions, and it was developed for the suggested topology. The switching pulses generated by the allocated logic functions control all inverter switches, establishing common-mode voltage (CMV) fluctuation remains stationary through the inverter's performance. As a result, the inverter's leakage current is decreased throughout its operation.

articleTitle: A Blockchain-Based Framework for Building and Sharing Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) and blockchain are two disruptive technologies proving to be a powerful combination, improving virtually every industry. Research in Artificial Intelligence has come a long way, with many corporations, organizations and individuals greatly benefiting from Machine Learning services. This research work focuses on creating a Blockchain-based framework for building and sharing Machine Learning models. We break the framework into three components to understand it: Publishing AI Services, Contribution to AI Services, and Fetching Private Predictions from AI Services. In the first component, the framework allows corporations, organizations and individuals to publish their AI Services. In the second component, the framework incorporates machine learning practitioners who can contribute to AI Service Publishers by building models and datasets in exchange for a reward. Thirdly, the framework allows corporations, organizations and individuals with problems that could be solved with AI to solicit solutions from AI Service Publishers without sharing their data. This research utilizes the benefits of existing multi-party computation (MPC) libraries to build Machine Learning models that provide predictions on encrypted data.

articleTitle: Development of Piezoelectric Biosensors for Pathogen Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: A pathogen is a biological agent that causes disease or illness to its host organism. Rapid detection of pathogenic organisms is a crucial step towards ensuring the health and safety of human beings. This paper proposes an analysis of different designs of piezoelectric biosensors to identify and detect certain pathogens. The top surface of the proposed sensor is coated with a uniform layer of antibodies. Dimensions of each design were varied to obtain optimal results. Simulations were performed using the COMSOL Multiphysics software. Zinc oxide and PolyVinyliDeneFluoride (PVDF) were the two piezoelectric materials under consideration. Aluminium, Gold and Graphite were analysed as electrode materials for each design. The piezoelectric biosensor designs were simulated to obtain voltages generated in the presence and absence of an antigen. Difference in voltages produced can be used to detect the presence of a pathogen.

articleTitle: Multi-Class Kannada Character Recognition Using Machine Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: Language plays a significant role in the identity of a person, it expresses history and culture. But with increasing popularity of cosmopolitan culture, the new generation is moving away from their origin. Karnataka is one of the most popular states in India which welcomes people from different geographical locations, because of its hospitality, weather, technological forefront etc. On the other hand, it impacts the usage of Kannada language and it challenges the demographic identity of the place. This paper aims to enhance the usage of Kannada language by automatic handwritten Kannada character recognition. In this work MSRIT Kannada handwritten dataset is used to classify 603 characters, which includes consonants, vowels, numbers, ottaksharas and consonants with vowels, using Decision Tree (DT), Convolutional Neural networks (CNN), Support Vector Classifier (SVC). The machine learning algorithms are modeled in python and achieved test accuracy of 97.42% using the decision tree method.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Alzheimer's Disease Detection using Multimodal MRI-PET Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is an irremediable brain disorder that is progressive and causes irreparable damage to brain cells, neurotransmitters, and nerves. This in turn severely affects brain functionalities and ultimately leads to dementia. Although there is currently no cure for AD, there are treatments that can slow down the disease's development. Hence, early diagnosis of AD is the need of the hour and researchers across the world have shifted their focus on developing robust and intelligent systems that can aid in early and accurate diagnosis of AD this has been the main motivation behind this study. The main objective of this paper is to present a comparative study of 2D and 3D Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architectures for AD classification and to choose the most robust model for AD classification. The models are trained on MRI and PET individually and with the fusion of MRI and PET. 2D feature fusion is performed using pre-trained neural networks and 3D fusion involves a series of operations such as skull-stripping, image segmentation, and co-registration. 2D CNN provided the highest accuracy of 91.29% on MRI images followed by 3D CNN with an accuracy of 91.07%. Comparing the performance on multimodal fusion, 3D MRI -PET fusion exhibited a significantly good accuracy of 86.90%. This paper briefly describes the GUI developed for easy visualization of AD classification and the possibilities of integrating the trained machine learning models with various mobile and web applications and with instruments that facilitate real-time diagnosis and classification of AD.

articleTitle: Electrocardiogram based cardiovascular disease detection with Ensemble Learning Classifier
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: Cardiovascular diseases are the main causes of death in today's world. This has driven the need for new technology to be employed to help detect any heart diseases faster and more conveniently. The goal of this study is to develop a novel Electrocardiogram based cardiovascular disease detection method using an Ensemble classifier. A dataset of the various heart diseases, including normal heartbeat, was collected for this study. Many popular machine learning algorithms like K Nearest Neighbor, Logistic Regression, and Support Vector Machine were first executed for the collected dataset. To improve the performance, a new Ensemble classifier has been developed, which gives better performance than the other machine learning algorithms listed before. Then its performance was compared with the other machine learning algorithms. It is seen that the Ensemble classifier can provide an overall accuracy of 93% and outperform all the other ML algorithms. A comparison of the F1-Score and Accuracy of these algorithms for the cases of normal, abnormal heartbeat and myocardial infarction is given in the form of a graph. A comparison table of the accuracy of the existing algorithms is also presented.

articleTitle: Bearing Health Condition Monitoring- A Brief Exposition
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: Industrial machines run continuously to meet the set target. These machines comprise different components, and the rolling element bearing is one such component. Bearings provide smooth relative motion between two moving parts. In an industry where the machines are working continuously in hostile operating conditions, the bearings experience heavy loads. Hence, it leads to faster deterioration of the bearing's health and starts surfacing in the form of various defects in the bearing components. If these defects are not identified in the developing stage, it will cause the disastrous failure of the complete system. Hence, bearing condition health monitoring is a crucial aspect of machinery health monitoring, and a substantial amount of study has been done in this area. Bearing fault signatures can be identified by using vibration data, acoustic signals, bearing temperature, wear debris analysis, etc. or in a combination of these parameters. The vibration data measurement is a quick, accurate and mostly followed technique in the bearing condition monitoring field. Various time, frequency & time-frequency domain vibration analysis methods are used to extract the bearing fault signatures from the vibration signal accurately. This review paper consolidates the methods used in bearing condition monitoring using vibration data and evaluates them based on their merits, demerits and limitations.

articleTitle: Botnet Forensic Analysis in Software Defined Networks using Ensemble Based Classifier
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: Software Defined Networks (SDN), a developing technology is replacing the conventional networking solutions that are currently in use. It helps greatly with network programmability and disassociates data plane from control plane. Due to its centralized administration, SDN is susceptible to number of threats. Botnet attacks are the most predominant kind of attacks. Peer-to-peer (P2P) botnets are a new, sophisticated variety of botnets. It is a decentralized network of computers that lack C & C servers and have been infected with malware and cooperate for the benefit of an attacker without the owners' permission. To combat botnet attacks, there are networking system solutions that use a single machine learning (ML) classifier, like the Support Vector Machine (SVM), decision tree (DT), etc. To create a more dependable and precise detection and mitigation application, detection speeds must be improved. In order to provide a system that effectively detects, classifies botnet traffic as Peer-to-Peer (P2P) and mitigates it, this paper uses extensive forensic analysis by combining SDN with decision tree and bagging integrated as ensemble machine learning classifiers to satisfy the necessary needs. This suggested method has 97 percent accuracy rate for identifying and mitigating botnet attacks on SDN networks.

articleTitle: Optimization Algorithm-Enabled Handover Management for Decision Making in 5G Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: At present, single wireless technology cannot meet all the demands of mobile users, and owing to such requirements, like Quality of Service (QoS) provision, efficiency, mobility, and cost, it is very prominent to incorporate diverse wireless technologies. Moreover, it is necessary to establish an efficient handover approach that allows mobile nodes (MN) to continuously move between different wireless networks that overlap with each other. A plethora of handover decision approaches have been developed in various literatures but, they are monolithic in nature and thus result in high computational cost and misbalancing of the network. In order to mitigate handover price owing to the densification of the network, an efficacious handover model is established for providing handover in Fifth Generation (5G) network. The proposed approach is mainly comprised of four components, namely the Network Quality of Service (NQ) module, User Preference (UP) module, power module and Decision System (DS) module. Here, the contribution of DS module is to make decisions on whether to offer handover in 5G network or not and the decision is selected based on proposed optimizations, such as Crow Search Algorithm (CSA) and Sun Flower Optimization (SFO), separately. However, the proposed CSA has obtained the maximum received power of - 93.706, throughput of 708.910, and USR of 0.647.

articleTitle: Transforming towards 6G: Critical Review of Key Performance Indicators
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: With the experiences acquired upon the successful implementation of 5G networks academia, researchers, and industry are envisioning the need for 6G networks. The vision of the 6G communication network is supposed to completely assist the creation of a Ubiquitous Intelligent Mobile Society. Already 5G technologies are in place and still few extended features of 5G are continuously being introduced. Even though the 6G communication network is expected to have greater capabilities than the existing 5G, there are no clear specifications on how far these capabilities shall be capitalized in 6G. The 6G technologies shall move past ordinary mobile internet services and advance to support ubiquitous Artificial Intelligent (AI) services from the network's core to end-to-end service devices/applications. The architecture, protocols, and operations which are the primary constituents of the 6G network shall implement AI technologies for self-optimization and actualization. This article brings an all-inclusive deliberation of 6G based on an assessment of preceding generations' evolving technology developments.

articleTitle: LoRA-IoT based Intelligent Healthcare Device for Physically Challenged People in Hospital Application using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: Continuously monitoring and tracking of patient health data can be a daunting task in a hospital. However, some people require regular monitoring due to physiological needs in order to maintain a healthy lifestyle. Especially for the elderly and those who have been in a coma for a long time, it is critical to regularly measure and inform their loved ones' wellness at work. This research work proposed an innovative LoRa-loT-based intelligent healthcare system using Artificial intelligence. All patients' healthcare data can be transmitted to Cloud through the LoRA transceiver. Also, the bed up/down can be controlled through Online Voice Command using Artificial Intelligence. An intelligent hospital health remote control system has been proposed to monitor patients' health at a hospital and acquire a doctor's prescription. Doctors can also identify patients' illnesses using data collected remotely from them. Android-based mobile applications are utilized as an interface for web-based applications to execute effective real-time communication involving doctors and patients using LoRA-IoT. This approach uses five sensors to collect data from the hospital environment: a heart rate sensor, a body temperature sensor, a room-temperature sensor, a CO sensor, and a max30100 sensor. Incorporating specific functions in mobile intelligent hospital automation equipment enables remote monitoring at the hospital and makes life more comfortable. As a result, patients who have caused self-isolation or self-isolation can use one of the most significant variables, the mobile phone, to convey their daily health symptoms and difficulties to their doctor. As a result, it will be able to enhance patient health and live a more pleasant life.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Classification of Welded Components
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: Welding is one of the most common approaches employed for fusing metals. However, welding errors are usually encountered during the process due to external factors. The detection and classification of these welding faults are of great importance for the reliability of the weld and the materials which were welded. Traditionally, welding error detection is performed through visual inspection carried out by inspectors or quality control personnel, which is an error-prone and slow process. In this paper, an image processing and machine learning based algorithm is proposed to automatically detect welding defects. The detection of component irregularities and classification is essential in quality control in manufacturing processes. Machine learning algorithms are widely employed for various applications as it reduces the precious human visualization time to classify the welded components manually and errors due this, which cannot be completely eliminated. The proposed algorithm also allows acceptance sampling or 100<sup>%</sup> inspection of the components as the speed of the classification process is within a few milliseconds with higher accuracy. The presented components are classified into Grades - A, B, C, and D with images obtained in visible spectrum. Experimental results prove that random forest classifier provided an accuracy of 82.8% compared to 77.6<sup>%</sup> of decision trees. Therefore, the welding evaluation process is made effective through machine learning based algorithms. The advantage is that automating the evaluation process makes it quicker and provides an unbiased grading.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Riesz Fractional Order Digital Differentiator using Arithmetic Optimization Algorithm for QRS Complex Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: An optimized zero phase response fractional order digital differentiator called Riesz Fractional order digital differentiator is proposed in this article by applying recently developed metaheuristic algorithm called Arithmetic Optimization Algorithm for accurate ECG QRS detection.The zero phase response helps to preserve the features of differentiated ECG and magnitude characteristics of proposed AOA based Riesz Fractional Order Digital Differentiator helps to obtain highly differentiated ECG.These two primitive properties of proposed Riesz Fractional order digital differentiator accomodate QRS detector to identify R peaks location more precisely.The suggested Method is evaluated using MIT-BIH Data Base. The matlab tool is used to evaluate the experiment results.

articleTitle: A Novel Framework for Network Based Secure Message Transmission Based on Fragmentation and Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: Here, crypto message fragmentation technique is applied to guarantee the immutability, non-repudiation, reliability, integrity and synchronization of the message during transmission. Multipath routing protocols' are used to get over the single path routing protocols' drawbacks and achieving high performance. The message is encrypted using standard encryption algorithms that are chosen at random: this randomization makes cryptanalysis more difficult. Data availability, data integrity and data's secrecy are addressed in an ad hoc network environment using Secure Message Transmission (SMT). There is no requirement for link encryption because the SMT technique operates end-to-end and between the source and destination nodes, assuming security association (SA). Although it may be used to support end-to-end communication encryption, data integrity and origin authentication are guaranteed by this SA between the end nodes.

articleTitle: Classification of Ventricular Arrhythmia using Machine Learning and Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: ECG is one of the most important and commonly used tools to detect any kind of abnormality in the heart. One such abnormality is arrhythmia, an irregular pattern which can lead to sudden cardiac arrest and even death. The number of deaths caused by cardiac arrest, which is a result of arrhythmia, has recently increased, and keeping this in view various models have been developed using machine learning and deep learning techniques and have worked on similar terms to provide better results in terms of accuracy. There are many forms of arrhythmias, and this work focuses on the methods used to classify one of the most dangerous forms of arrhythmias which is Ventricular Arrhythmia based on the ECG datasets collected from MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database, MIT-BIH Supraventricular Arrhythmia Database, INCART 12-lead Database. The study presents insights into classification of ventricular arrhythmia using models such as Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), Dense Neural Network (DNN) and Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) and the way they are trained with beats and labels that are then used for classification. The study focuses on comparing the classification results of all the three techniques based on accuracy, AUC score, recall, prevalence, precision and specificity in order to conclude the best classifier among them in terms of various performance parameters so that it can be adapted for clinical use.

articleTitle: A Brief Overview of the Respiratory Sound Based Detection of Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease(COPD)
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: Lung sound reflects the lung morphology. Changes in behavior of respiratory sound could be the direct indicator of changes in the lung morphology due to pulmonary diseases. Computerized lung sound analysis is one of the cost effective as well as the non-invasive tool to analyze respiratory diseases. Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) is one of the chronic lung diseases whose correct diagnosis is very difficult as well as whose health cost is very high. Researchers have proposed several interesting methodologies in diagnosing such disease based on LS. However, it is essential to identify the available lung sound (LS) based diagnostic system which could be able to effectively detect COPD in a better way. This study is all about to identify the exact LS based diagnostic procedure which could be a considerable and effective one for diagnosing COPD. In comparison to all of the existing LS based methodologies, one study produced the highest classification accuracy of 99.7%. In that the study the LS recordings were effectively denoised using EMD and DWT, followed by feature extraction in various domains. Next to this, feature selection was conducted using the back elimination method to identify the best features. Those selected features were then given input to quadratic discriminant classifier to diagnose COPD. This LS based diagnostic procedure outperformed with classification accuracy of 99.7% It is concluded that this study has successfully identified the most effective automated LS based procedure to correctly detect COPD. This methodology can even be recommended clinically as to support physicians for diagnosing COPD. However, existing studies have not included the LS data of COPD patients having other comorbidities. The future endeavor of this study is to implement such a LS based diagnostic system which could detect COPD even in COPD patients with other comorbidities.

articleTitle: Mitigation of DDoS Attack in SDN using Table Miss-entry
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: SDNs or Software Defined Networks differ from traditional networks due to the separation of the control and data plane. However, it is this centralized control that makes SDNs prone to DDoS attacks if the network operations are not addressed properly. One of the ways to cause DDoS is through an influx of control messages (PACKET_IN); due to the Flow Table Miss-entry rule, such attacks can be carried out rather easily. In this work, the aim is to look at DDoS attacks targeting the controller by generating large PACKET_IN traffic from switches and overwhelming them with large amounts of new requests. Such an attack causes the controller to not be able to serve even legitimate traffic. This research looks at effective detection and mitigation techniques utilizing the SNORT IDS that may be used to prevent such attacks from causing any significant harm to the network.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Qualitative and Quantitative Approach for Automatic Short Answer Grading Using Classification Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: Assessment plays a very important role in the teaching-learning process. Recently proposed techniques for short answer grading are either Qualitative or Quantitative. Qualitative methods use classification and give scores in an incomprehensible way like correct, incorrect, partially correct, etc., and Quantitative methods use Regression and MSE(Mean Square Error) which assigns scores like 2.3,4.2, etc. requires a learning method to convert those values to integers. In this paper, a hybrid Qualitative Quantitative approach is proposed which is based on machine learning that relies on Multi-class classification where each category of marks is considered as a class. This can be easily converted to qualitative or quantitative systems without additional learning methods. This system follows a model answer-based method where various similarities are extracted from both model and student answers including statistical, Bag of Words, TFIDF, Latent Semantic Analysis, and Neural sentence embedding based Infersent. Using these features various classification models are designed including K Nearest Neighbor, Naïve Bayes, Decision tree, SVM, Random Forest, and XGBoost for various test sizes of the data and cross-validations. The models are tested on a dataset that consists of one question, 80 answers, and a model answer. In total, 72 experiments are conducted, demonstrating that the proposed hybrid approach can be effectively applied to the Automatic Short Answer Grading (ASAG) task.

articleTitle: Using Neural Networks To Map Context Features To Probability Distributions
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: Mixture Density Networks (MDN) is a type of neural network model which is used for predicting the target in high dimensional space. In MDN, there are adaptive mixture weights that come from the target distribution. Mixture Density Networks are comparatively more accurate than “traditional clustering” algorithms, as they use a better estimator - probability. Mixture density networks can be represented with the X vector of probabilities all pointing to a different certain class, where each dimension of the vector is an outcome of an event/input in order to classify something that may occur or is also called a multinomial classification. In this paper, mixture density networks are used for contextual pitch prediction. The authors focus on developing models that aim to model the distribution of pitch types and their contexts to help model at bats and predict the outcomes. It was observed that MDNs are well suited for modelling this distribution.

articleTitle: Data analysis of Global Perceived Stress Scores During Covid-19
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: The Covid-19 Pandemic that broke out in late December 2019 has had a widespread negative effect on the mental health of people around the world. This work aims to elicit features that had a major influence on mental health during the pandemic to better understand preventive measures and remedial actions that can be taken to help individuals in need. Along with factors such as demographic age, gender, marital status, and employment status, additional information such as the effect of media used as a source of information, coping methods, trust in the country's government, and healthcare organizations was analyzed to find their correlation (if any) to the perceived stress of the individual. Machine Learning techniques such as XGBoost, AdaBoost, Decision Trees, Ordinal regression, k-Nearest Neighbors, Lasso and Ridge regression were used to arrive at a relationship between the perceived stress scores and the features considered. On interpreting results from the different models, we conclude that the main factor influencing stress scores was loneliness followed by features indicating trust in government, compliance with Covid-19 preventive measures and concerns regarding the pandemic.

articleTitle: Detection and Prediction of Lung Cancer Employing Image processing and Machine Learning techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: Lung cancer irrespective of caste, age and gender is a major cause of deaths among people. Survival rate increases upon early detection of the same. In medical image processing identifying lung cancer is active research and also early-stage detection is essential. In Lung cancer pulmonary nodules of the lungs are primarily affected. The critical task is to detect a lung nodule. Computed Tomography (CT) images are a natural choice due to built-in features of low cost, clarity, low noise, minimal latency, and distortion. CT Images are from the standard Kaggle repository. Lung cancer detection and prediction using image pre-processing and machine learning techniques is a standard method used to classify the CT images of lung cancer. A primary task in image pre-processing is to reduce the noises like Gaussian, impulses, and speckles from images. A pre-processing stage is realized with filtering techniques. This work has used Support Vector Machine (SVM) for prediction of lung cancer with accuracy of 88%.

articleTitle: Comparison of Machine Learning Algorithms for EMG based Muscle Function Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 4th International Conference on Circuits, Control, Communication and Computing (I4C)
abstract: Electromyography (EMG) is the process of measuring the electrical activity that is produced during the muscle activation and is also called as myoelectric signal. This electrical activity can be recorded to analyze the performance of any muscle. Machine learning algorithms can be deployed to predict the presence of abnormality in the muscles. In this study, we have worked on predicting the possibilities of cervicalgia, more commonly known as neck pain, by using distinct time domain features extracted from surface EMG signals recorded from SCM muscle, and performing the comparative analysis of different machine learning binary classifier algorithms like Support Vector Machine (SVM), K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Random Forest, Decision Tree, Naïve Bayes Classifier and Logistic Regression. The feature selection was made using techniques like PCA and Pearson's Correlation Matrix. Maximum classification accuracy of 91.6% was achieved. If predicted well in advance, they can provide valid information to doctors, physiotherapists, yoga therapists or medical practitioners, who can then adapt their diagnosis and treatment for each patient.
